correctness.rationale: For each graph K_3 square P_n, n>=4, a zero in the middle of three columns a,b,c has total neighbor weight w(b)+a_r+c_r, so the zero-vertex condition equals exactly 2 for every zero row. This gives an exact 27-column alphabet and 729-pair min-plus/tied-count transfer automaton with boundary phantom zero columns. Independent construction from scratch found 306 reachable ordered pair states and EXACT full-state D14=shift_1(D13), with base minima and multiplicities (n+2,6) for all n=4..14. The transition and terminal acceptance commute with uniform shifts, so this finite exact identity extends the optimum and six minimizers inductively for all n>=4, not by finite extrapolation. The six explicit row-permutation periodic assignments have weight n+2 and satisfy each zero-neighbor equation; since the counted number of minima is six there are no other minima or label-2 minima. n=2,3 excluded.
